summary: Custom templates let you offer a narrow form to less experienced users and a detailed one to experts for the same job template. The portal authenticates to AAP through an OAuth application and supports only one AAP instance and one organization.
questions: Can self-service automation portal connect to multiple AAP instances?
How does the portal authenticate to AAP?
Can the portal use more than one AAP organization?

answer_card.title: Self-service portal limits
answer_card.answer_md:
- Authenticates to AAP through an **OAuth application**.
- Only **one** AAP instance.
- Only **one** AAP organization.
